title: Senior Recruitment Consultant
description: We are seeking an experienced Recruitment Consultant to join our growing team. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and placing top talent for our clients across various industries.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field

title: Data Analyst
description: Join our analytics team to provide data-driven insights to our clients. You will analyze complex datasets, create visualizations, and develop actionable recommendations.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, or related field
Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI)

title: Training Coordinator
description: Help us design and deliver impactful training programs for our clients. You will coordinate training sessions, develop materials, and evaluate program effectiveness.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Education, HR, or related field
Ability to work with diverse groups

title: Marketing Specialist
description: Drive our marketing initiatives to increase brand awareness and generate leads. You will manage campaigns, create content, and analyze marketing performance metrics.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
Proficiency in digital marketing tools and analytics

title: HR Officer
description: Support our HR operations including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and compliance. You will be the first point of contact for employee inquiries.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in HR Management or related field

title: IT Support Specialist
description: Provide technical support and maintain our IT infrastructure. You will troubleshoot issues, implement solutions, and ensure smooth operations of all technology systems.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field
Experience with Windows/Mac systems and networks
